annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) – IMCO/LIBE compromise amendments, Title III Chapter 4 and recitals
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) – IMCO/LIBE compromise amendments, Title III Chapter 4 and recitals
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament, Committee on the Internal Market and Consumer Protection (IMCO) and Committee on Civil Liberties, Justice and Home Affairs (LIBE); Rapporteurs Benifei & Tudorache
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament IMCO/LIBE compromise text (May 2023) on the draft AI Act, covering notifying authorities, notified bodies and conformity assessment of high-risk AI systems, plus recitals on delegated acts, environmental impact, AI literacy and application dates. General AI content with no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States must designate notifying authorities to assess, designate and monitor conformity assessment bodies.
Notified bodies must be independent, competent and meet minimum cybersecurity requirements (NIS2).
Notified bodies verify conformity of high-risk AI systems under Article 43 procedures.
Commission to pursue mutual recognition agreements on conformity assessment with comparable countries.
Providers and deployers must ensure AI literacy of staff; Commission to review prohibited and high-risk lists annually.
